captions.detailed: An under-slung three-branch rotary frame featuring a dark-colored top horizontal bridge support. From this bridge, three separate, independent brackets hang downward, each holding a long, slender, dark vertical arm. The three hanging arms are designed to rotate independently via separate revolute joints relative to their respective brackets.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an under-slung three-branch rotary frame. The assembly should feature a top horizontal bridge support and three independent, vertically hanging arms, each connected to its own bracket on the underside of the bridge via independent revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct the base bridge frame using a long box with decorative end caps and a recessed top channel. Model the three brackets on the underside of the bridge as small cylindrical flanges. Create the three hanging arms by lofting or extruding a rectangular cross-section into a slender vertical rod, capping the top with a cylindrical connector. Set up the three independent revolute joints connecting each arm to its corresponding bracket on the bridge using the rigid transform helper classes.
